name: [ADMIN ABUSE] 67 Simulator
desc:
🔥 Welcome to 67 Simulator!

Chain 67s, collect aura, and rise to become the ultimate 67 GOD. Battle against the evil 67 kid's forces across multiple worlds and defeat powerful bosses. Mog your opponents and prove you're the most goated player to ever live!

🎉 [DEBUT RELEASE]
This is our first release! Play now to be a founding 67 Simulator player. More worlds, bosses, and brainrot coming soon.

❓ [How to Play]
- 🤲 Hit timing-based quicktime events to do 67s
- 🔗 Chain 67s together to do the emote faster and faster
- ✨ Earn Aura from high chains
- 💀 Mog your opponents in aura battles
- 🛒 Spend Aura at Chopped Chin's Shop
- 🐾 Collect Brainrot Pets
- 🌍 Explore New Worlds and defeat Bosses!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players

👍 Like the game and join the group for exclusive rewards!
🔔 Follow for update news and free codes!

⚠️ WARNING: Exploiters will be permanently banned. Our anti-cheat is always watching. 

Become the 67 God. 🏆
